description: Correct one stored place visit (visit_id from get_place_visits or log_place_visit): arrived_at, departed_at (null when unknown), arrival_time_precision, or place_id (another of your places, places.id). Fields left out stay. Times read as log_place_visit reads them: YYYY-MM-DD is the day with no clock time; a clock time without an offset is in the account timezone. duration_minutes is recomputed. An edit that would leave two open visits at one place is refused (CONFLICT). Never creates a visit or a place. ($0.10; API key required)

arrival_time_precision.description: approximate when the clock time reads a part of day (evening → 19:00).

arrived_at.description: ISO 8601 (with offset, or wall time in the account timezone), or YYYY-MM-DD when only the day is known.

departed_at.description: ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD; null when the departure is unknown.

place_id.description: Move the visit to another of your places (place_id from get_place_visits or get_places).

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

visit_id.description: UUID of a place_visits row: visit_id from get_place_visits or log_place_visit.
